thread:
alex: Morning — planning a sunrise rollout: kernel v2.14 + quant profile q4 to us-east slices. Target window 08:00 PT (about 35m from now). Who can own smoke and rollback?
priya: I can own smoke. Will run the perf and correctness checklist.
lina: I can be on rollback standby and watch metrics.
tom: I can shepherd the deploy CLI and handle stage gating. Will be on call.
alex: Awesome. Priya—can you run the reduced prompt set first then full smoke if green? Quick checklist: 1) basic gen + chat flows 2) kv cache hit sanity 3) p50/p95 token latency 4) model mismatch/noise checks 5) outage fallback test (route to v2.13).
priya: Yep. I'll run small set locally then kick the canary. Expected runtime ~10m. Sharing cmds in a sec.
priya: ```
# canary deploy
redwoodctl deploy --env us-east --model kernel-v2.14 --quant q4 --slice canary-1 --timeout 1800
redwoodctl smoke --suite perf+correctness --targets canary-1
```
priya: I'll post results here.
priya: Quick note: quant q4 has known tokenization variance on long prompts (~>1024) — will include long-prompt check.
alex: Good catch. Lina — rollback procedure?
lina: If anything looks off I'll trigger rollback to kernel v2.13 using deployctl rollback. Steps: 1) mark canary unhealthy 2) scale canary to 0 3) promote v2.13 slices. I'll call it out before doing it.
tom: I'll watch autoscaler and GPU mem. Keep an eye on OOMs and high nvtop mem. If we see >85% sustained GPU mem across canary nodes -> abort.
priya: Smoke results: basic pass, kv cache ok, p50 up 8% (expected), p95 within SLO. Long-prompt check: slight token jitter on one sample (same as noted earlier).
alex: Thanks. Can we run a quick regen test with function-calling enabled? That's a heavy path.
priya: Running now.
priya: regen test looks fine. No API-level errors and function-calls return stable. CPU spike on orchestrator but within baseline.
deploy-bot: rollout scheduled: id=roll-3490012345, canary=canary-1 -> start=3490012600, owner=tom.
alex: Ok let's do a slow expand to 10% traffic in 10m increments. Tom will gate each step. If any of us react with :thumbsup: we continue. If any :x: we pause and evaluate rollback.
lina: I'll be ready to flip if we get error-rate >1% or latency p95 >SLO+20%.
tom: Starting step 1 now. ping me with any anomalies, I'll hold the button.
priya: step 1 metrics look stable — thumbs up from me. :thumbsup:
alex: Great. Proceed.
priya: step 2 expanding.
tom: Observed slight increase in tail latency on one host, investigating pinning to kernel flags. Holding until I confirm.
priya: If you want I can repro the tail locally with the same seed.
tom: Do that, please. If repro matches, we'll rollback that host and keep rest.
priya: Repro confirms tail spike on the same sequence. Sending logs: ``ERROR tokenize mismatch`` on host us-east-3.
lina: Rolling back us-east-3 slice only to v2.13, scaling it down from canary. Notifying infra.
deploy-bot: rollback action initiated: target=us-east-3, from=kernel-v2.14, to=kernel-v2.13, id=rb-3490012345-1
priya: After rollback host metrics normalized, overall p95 back to baseline.
alex: Good call. Continue slow expand but exclude us-east-3 until we get a patch. Tom—file an issue with kernel + quant logs and label P1-slice.
tom: Filed: INF-7221 with logs and repro steps. Will follow up.
priya: Final notes: leave q4 toggled off on long-prompt routes until we patch. Everything else green.
alex: Thanks everyone. I'll update the rollout doc and mark this window as partial-success. We'll schedule a follow-up to triage INF-7221. :coffee:
